items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: What about a couple of these gals like say, Betty Carter or Dee Dee Bridgewater.

ctx.x: What about a couple of these gals like say, Betty Carter or Dee Dee Bridgewater. You may not even had much opportunity to have heard them.
Well, Betty Carter and I worked a concert that we sung in together. /That was the first time I heard her.
